narrative: Day 2 is the Kick-off Meeting (Milestone M02), held as a full-day session at the QSE office in Tashkent from 10:00 to 16:30 under an overcast, windy and cold sky. Helios EPC presents its organisation, the outline Level 1-3 baseline schedule and the NTP precondition checklist, while QSE and Meridian set out reporting, communication and document review expectations. There is still no presence on the Qizilqum site; all work is office-based and focused on governance, the road to NTP on 15 December and the advance payment guarantee.

Record KOM decisions and actions with owners and due dates, including NTP preconditions, APG/Performance Security form approval and baseline schedule submission
